run_trf015_lint: run the TRF015 lint check on a transformers modeling file to detect missing tie_word_embeddings in config classes
check_tie_word_embeddings_violations: check a Python AST tree for TRF015 violations where models define _tied_weights_keys but config lacks tie_word_embeddings
find_config_file_for_modeling: find the corresponding configuration file for a given modeling or modular Python file path
resolve_config_class_from_modeling: resolve the config class name from a modeling class by following local inheritance and assignments
infer_config_class_by_prefix: infer the matching config class name from a modeling class using the longest shared prefix
